functions.name: batch-enrich-leads
functions.description: Submit 1–100 leads in a single background enrichment request with shared email, phone, profile, and workflow options.

lastName.description: Person's last name as ordinary text.

firstName.description: Person's first name as ordinary text.

companyName.description: Employer name; supply this or companyDomain.

linkedinUrl.description: Public person LinkedIn URL; required for every row when enrichProfile=true.

customFields.description: String-valued metadata echoed by name for correlation; empty object is permitted and omission sends none.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata value preserved unchanged for correlation.

items.description: A known person identified by name and employer.

leads.description: People to enrich in one native batch; maximum 100.

options.description: Choices applied to every lead; omission requests email only.

enrichEmail.description: Find and verify work emails; defaults to true independently of other choices.

enrichPhone.description: Find mobile numbers; requires the phone add-on.

enrichProfile.description: Retrieve LinkedIn profiles; every lead must have linkedinUrl.

processFlowId.description: Existing process-flow identifier provided by the account owner; requires its add-on. Omission uses the normal provider flow.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum background waterfall duration in seconds; omission uses the account timeout, not this tool's call budget.

verifyCatchAll.description: Run extra catch-all verification; requires the catch-all add-on.

FunctionInput_bettercontact_batchenrichl.description: Submit known people for background enrichment with shared options.

id.description: Opaque enrichment request ID covering the submitted batch.

message.description: Provider acknowledgement text; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_bettercontact_batchenrich.description: Aggregate acknowledgement of an accepted enrichment batch, not per-lead results.

tags.instructions: Use for 1–100 known people; use `enrich-lead` for a single person. Include customFields such as a CRM ID for correlation rather than relying on result order. Save the returned ID and call `get-lead-enrichment` later. Submission confirms only that a batch was accepted, not success for each lead. Requested enrichment can consume credits and add-ons are required for phone, catch-all, and custom process flows.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

isPublic.description: True restricts to publicly listed companies; omit for no filter. False is passed unchanged without assuming inverse semantics.

keywords.description: Free-text phrases matched against the company profile.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

linkedinUrls.description: Company LinkedIn page URLs to include.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

technologies.description: Exact technology taxonomy labels, for example Salesforce.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

revenueRanges.description: Exact revenue-bracket taxonomy labels, for example $20M-$100M.

through.description: Inclusive latest funding date, YYYY-MM-DD, without timezone conversion.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

headquartersLocations.description: Cities, states or countries matched against full headquarters addresses.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

items.description: A filter value, preserving ordinary text and taxonomy case.

FunctionInput_bettercontact_createcompan.description: Create one asynchronous company-search page using initial criteria or an opaque continuation alone.

id.description: Opaque company-search request ID for get-company-search.

FunctionOutput_bettercontact_createcompa.description: Acknowledgement identifying the submitted background company-search request.

tags.instructions: Use to discover companies, not to look up one known company (`enrich-company-profile`). Start with filters and optionally limit (1–200, default 100), then call `get-company-search` with the returned ID. To request another page, pass its nextCursor here with no new criteria. Each invocation creates one asynchronous page request and may spend credits or quota; it does not wait for completion.

functions.name: enrich-company-profile

functions.name: enrich-lead

lastName.description: Person's last name as ordinary text.

companyName.description: Employer name; provide this or companyDomain, with domain preferred.

additionalProperties.description: Correlation metadata value echoed unchanged in results.

companyName.description: Employer name; provide this or companyDomain, with domain preferred.

lead.description: Person to enrich, with names and a company identifier.

options.description: Enrichment choices; omission requests email only.

enrichEmail.description: Find and verify the work email; defaults to true independently of other options.

enrichPhone.description: Find the mobile number; requires the phone add-on.

enrichProfile.description: Retrieve the LinkedIn profile; requires the lead's linkedinUrl.

processFlowId.description: Existing process-flow identifier supplied by the account owner; requires the process-flow add-on. Omission uses the provider's normal flow.

timeoutSeconds.description: Background waterfall time budget in seconds, not the duration of this tool call. Omission uses the account's configured timeout.

verifyCatchAll.description: Run additional catch-all verification; requires the catch-all add-on.

FunctionInput_bettercontact_enrichlead.description: Submit one known person for background enrichment with explicit enrichment choices.

id.description: Opaque enrichment request identifier to pass as enrichmentRequestId to get-lead-enrichment.

message.description: Provider's submission acknowledgement, omitted if absent.

tags.instructions: Use for one known person's email or phone enrichment. Use `enrich-lead-profile` for a synchronous profile-only lookup, or `batch-enrich-leads` for up to 100 people. Save the returned ID and call `get-lead-enrichment` later; submission does not establish that contact details were found. Phone and catch-all options require paid add-ons and the work may consume credits.
